mapper.select:
SELECT ds.* FROM down_sync ds INNER JOIN ( SELECT data_uuid, MAX(data_version) as max_version FROM down_sync WHERE sync_status = 0
AND create_time > STR_TO_DATE(#{lastTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
GROUP BY data_uuid ) latest ON ds.data_uuid = latest.data_uuid AND ds.data_version = latest.max_version WHERE ds.sync_status = 0 ORDER BY ds.create_time ASC
